look_here_first: Start with habit and leaflet size: a xeric shrub or small tree with tiny leathery, often nearly evergreen leaflets—commonly only three per leaf.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: rocky limestone slopes and dry washes

lookalikes.differences: Much smaller and more xeric than Texas or Mexican ash; tiny coriaceous leaflets are the fastest field cue.
